observedOfficialCapabilities: The live SD results app exposes current election CSV/media/export pages and ResultsAjax service methods, but those public pages currently default to the 2026 Primary Election, not the 2024 General Election.

ResultsExport.aspx?eid=684 renders the official 2024 General Election export shell and the ASP.NET Statewide Export postback downloads Statewide Results.xlsx, retained locally as data/sd-2024-general-statewide-results.xlsx.
The WSDL exposes GetMapDataArchive, GetVoterTurnoutArchive, and GetProvisionalDataArchive methods that require an integer ElectionID.
A Wayback capture of the official results root from 2024-11-05 confirms the archived shell was the 2024 General Election and referenced the older SD results service root.

The older official SD results service identifies ElectionID 684 as the 2024 General Election candidate archive: GetCandidates returns Trump, Harris, Oliver, Kennedy, Dusty Johnson, and Sheryl Johnson federal markers.
GetMapDataArchive with ElectionID 684, Type=SWR, Category=CTY, and RaceID=0 returns county map-data rows for 2024 federal races, including President map RaceID 12665 and U.S. House map RaceID 11954.

Race-specific Category=PREC endpoints return complete same-key President and U.S. House candidate rows for 691 CountyID-plus-StatePrecinctID units across all 66 counties. They are activated as explicitly unofficial review context, not certified results or geometry.

GetVoterTurnoutArchive with ElectionID 684 returns 66 county turnout rows. Its 436,478 calcVoterTurnout values exactly match the dated official Election Returns table, while its untimestamped Voters field is retained only for comparison.

The official Election Returns and Registration Figures report supplies 66 county turnout rows with 624,175 active voters as of November 5, 2024, 436,478 ballots cast, and 69.93% turnout; these rows now control active turnout.

The official ElectionID 684 archive remains lower than the certified county totals, but the retained State Canvass and Certificate PDF exactly reconciles the current 66-county President and U.S. House staging rows.
The retained official statewide XLSX export labels itself 2024 Unofficial General Election Results and reconciles to the lower ElectionID 684 map-data totals, not to the certified canvass.

ElectionTerminology.aspx?eid=684 states that Election Night results are unofficial and that official certified results are available from SOS Elections after the 66 County Canvass Boards and State Canvass Board canvass and certify results.

The official 2024 General post-election audit page lists 66 county rows, 83 linked audit certificate URLs, and 14 counties with discrepancy summary text. This is retained as administration context, not as a certified result source.
Wave 24 tested five likely 2024 State Canvass and Certificate PDF paths under the SOS 2024 election-information assets tree; all returned 404.
Wave 26 found the retained official certificate through the SOS 2024 Election History page and verifies its county tables deterministically in scripts/verify_sd_2024_general_canvass.py.
officialSourceProbe.blocker: The retained official State Canvass and Certificate PDF exactly validates all current 66-county President and U.S. House values, the official local endpoints support 691 same-grain review rows, and the official Election Returns report supplies compatible county active-voter turnout. South Dakota still needs a certified allocation for the 194 President and 184 U.S. House votes absent from the unofficial local ENR rows, precinct geometry/crosswalk evidence, official historical baselines, and normalized administration context before it can be treated as completed official-native coverage.

archiveProbe.method: Queried the archived official SD ResultsAjax service and retained candidate, county and local map-data, turnout archive evidence, and the official ResultsExport.aspx?eid=684 statewide XLSX workbook for 2024 General ElectionID 684.
archiveProbe.result: ElectionID 684 returned 2024 General Election federal candidate markers, county and local map-data rows, turnout rows, and a scriptable statewide XLSX export. The President and U.S. House Category=PREC endpoints share all 691 reporting-unit keys. President RaceID 12665 totals 428,728 votes and U.S. House RaceID 11954 totals 421,264 votes, respectively 194 and 184 below the certified canvass; the local rows therefore remain explicitly unofficial review context with no manufactured certified allocation.

turnoutLeadDecision.reason: The official report identifies the denominator as active voters as of November 5, 2024 and supplies all 66 county rows. Its ballots-cast values exactly match the ENR archive. The untimestamped ENR Voters field and the EAC total-registration denominator remain comparison provenance and are not mixed with active turnout percentages.

displayCaveats: Current 66-county President and U.S. House staging values are exactly validated against the retained official State Canvass and Certificate PDF. The generated county CSVs retain their secondary extraction lineage rather than becoming a direct certificate-table parser.

Review charts use 691 official-source ElectionID 684 President-versus-at-large-U.S.-House reporting units. The application labels them unofficial; their totals are 194 President votes and 184 U.S. House votes below the certified canvass, and those county deltas are not allocated locally.
Turnout uses the official 66-county Election Returns table: 436,478 ballots cast over 624,175 active voters as of November 5, 2024. It must not be described as an all-registered-voter denominator.
Historical baselines are contextual secondary county tables for 2012, 2016, and 2020.
County geometry is loaded; precinct geometry/crosswalks and normalized audit/CVR/recount/incident/correction/litigation rows are not loaded.
